# Lexy Lamparelli | Content Creator & Social Media Marketing Portfolio

> Alexia "Lexy" Lamparelli is a Boston, MA-based content creator and microinfluencer. She creates lifestyle, fashion, fitness, skincare, and hair care content, and works in social media marketing, Canva graphic design, brand design, and short-form video. This is her single-page portfolio at https://www.lexylamparelli.cv/.

## About

- Name: Alexia Lamparelli (goes by "Lexy")
- Role: Content creator and microinfluencer; Account Manager at National Corporate Housing
- Location: Boston, Massachusetts, United States
- Niche: Lifestyle, fashion, beauty, fitness, skincare, hair care
- Education: Digital Arts, California State University San Marcos
- Previous role: Director of Resident Experience at Bozzuto (advanced from Sales & Marketing Associate in under a year)

## Skills & Services
